diagnosis: The cryptocurrency ledger audit endpoint forks a child process and passes AUDIT_RUN_ID directly from the URL. The worker fetches cold storage wallet keys, balance reconciliations, and internal transaction logs from the database without any account ownership check. An attacker can trigger audits and view cold storage reserves of other cryptocurrency exchanges.
exploit_request:
POST /api/crypto/audits/run/audit_institutional_reserve_991 HTTP/1.1
Host: custody.crypto.internal:7007
Cookie: session_user=trader_low_priv
Accept: application/json
